title: All Hair Types
description:
Not every hair concern needs a specialist formula. This collection gathers the Evoque products that work well across straight, wavy, curly, fine and thick hair — the safe starting point if you are not sure which line suits you, or if you are buying for a household with different hair types.

Everything here is sulfate free, so it cleanses without stripping color or drying the scalp, and paraben free and cruelty free throughout. Formulas are balanced rather than heavy, meaning they hydrate fine hair without weighing it down and still deliver enough moisture for thicker textures.

If you have a specific concern — damage, frizz, color fade, hair fall or brassiness — the targeted collections will serve you better. For general upkeep, start here.

title: Anti Hair Loss & Scalp Care Shampoo - Hair Fall & Dandruff Treatment
description:
The Evoque Scalp Recovery collection targets the root causes of hair fall: a congested, inflamed or flaky scalp. Each product combines piroctone olamine for dandruff control with tea tree oil and argan oil to soothe irritation, balance oil production and strengthen hair at the follicle.

Build a complete anti-hair-loss routine: start with the Anti Hair Loss Shampoo to cleanse and stimulate, follow with the Conditioner for slip and moisture without weighing roots down, then apply the leave-in Scalp Serum directly to the scalp and finish with the Scalp Tonic for ongoing dandruff control. The full Scalp Recovery Set and Trio bundle the routine at a lower price.

Formulated for thinning hair, excessive shedding, oily scalp and dandruff. Sulfate free, paraben free and cruelty free salon-grade care.

title: Best Sellers - Hair Care & Styling Products
description:
These are the Evoque products customers reorder most, and the ones salons keep on the shelf. If you are new to the brand, start here.

The list is led by the Miracle Touch Leave-In Conditioner and BB Cream for humidity-proof, frizz-free hair, the Smart Keratin Restorative Shampoo and Deep Treatment Mask for damaged and chemically-treated hair, the Yogurt Leave-In Deep Treatment Mask for anti-frizz repair, and the Milk Therapy range for dry, brittle, color-treated hair.

Every bestseller is a salon-grade formula: sulfate free, paraben free, cruelty free and suitable for all hair types. Many are available in bundles that cost less than buying each product on its own, and in 100ml travel sizes if you want to try before committing to a full-size bottle. Free U.S. shipping on orders over $50.

title: Clay Mask
description:
The Evoque Green Clay Face Mask is a purifying treatment for oily, congested and acne-prone skin. Green clay works by absorption: it draws excess sebum, dirt and impurities out of the pores rather than simply cleansing the surface, which is why skin feels clarified rather than stripped afterwards.

Use it once or twice a week on clean, dry skin. Apply an even layer, avoid the eye area, leave for 10–15 minutes until it is touch-dry but not cracking, then rinse with warm water and follow with a moisturizer.

Best suited to oily and combination skin. Paraben free and cruelty free.

title: Conditioner
description:
Every Evoque conditioner in one place, from lightweight daily formulas to rich rinse-out treatments. A conditioner's job is to close the cuticle the shampoo opened, restore slip so hair detangles without breakage, and seal in moisture. Which one you need depends on what your hair is missing.

Pick Milk Therapy Hydrating Conditioner for dry, brittle, color-treated hair; Smart Keratin Restorative Conditioner for damage and frizz; Miracle Touch Smart Care for humidity resistance and shine; Healthy Care Protective Conditioner to keep dyed hair vibrant; Scalp Recovery Conditioner for thinning hair; and Plex Extreme S.O.S for bond rebuilding.

Available in 100ml travel, 380ml, 400ml, 1L and 2.8L bulk salon sizes. Sulfate free, paraben free and cruelty free.

title: Damaged and Frizzy Hair
description:
Damage and frizz are the same problem seen from two angles: a raised, porous cuticle that loses moisture and grabs humidity from the air. This collection brings together every Evoque product that closes that cuticle and rebuilds what heat, bleach and chemical services stripped out.

Start with structural repair: Plex Extreme S.O.S rebuilds broken bonds, while Smart Keratin refills the fiber with keratin and amino acids. Add weekly intensity with a Deep Treatment Mask. Then seal daily with an anti-frizz leave-in such as Miracle Touch Leave-In, BB Cream, Smart Keratin Frizz Control or the Leave-In Rescue Spray, all of which add heat protection up to 230°C.

For badly damaged hair, expect visible improvement within two to three weeks of consistent use. Sulfate free, paraben free and cruelty free.

title: Deep Treatment Mask
description:
A weekly deep treatment mask is the single highest-impact step you can add to a hair routine. Where conditioner works on the surface for a minute or two, a mask sits for five to ten minutes and drives proteins, amino acids and oils deep into the cortex where damage actually lives.

Match the mask to your hair: Milk Therapy Deep Treatment Masque and the Yogurt Leave-In Mask for dry, brittle, color-treated hair; Smart Keratin Deep Treatment Mask for damage, frizz and chemically-treated hair; Macadamia Cream Mask for thick, coarse density; Purple Mask for toning blonde and silver hair; Miracle Touch Repair Mask for humidity resistance; Hair Butter for the deepest moisture on curly and coarse textures.

Apply to clean, towel-dried hair, focus on mid-lengths and ends, leave 5–10 minutes, then rinse. Available in 50ml travel and 500ml salon sizes.

How to use a deep treatment mask

  1. Shampoo first, then squeeze out excess water so hair is clean and damp, not dripping.
  2. Apply the mask from mid-lengths to ends, where damage sits. Keep it off the scalp unless the label says otherwise.
  3. Comb through with a wide-tooth comb to spread it evenly.
  4. Leave it on for 5 to 10 minutes. A warm towel around the head helps it absorb.
  5. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water. Use it once a week, or twice a week for very dry or damaged hair.

title: Evoque Flawless Blonde Purple Shampoo & Hair Care Series
description:
Flawless Blonde is Evoque's toning range for blonde, silver, platinum and grey hair. Every product carries salon-grade violet pigment that neutralizes the warm yellow and brassy tones that appear between color appointments, while conditioning agents keep bleached hair soft rather than dry and straw-like.

The collection includes Purple Shampoo in 1L salon size for regular toning, the Purple Hair Mask in 250ml and 50ml travel size for deeper deposit and repair, plus the leave-in Purple Mousse and Purple Toning Foam for gentle daily upkeep that also adds body.

How often to tone depends on your base: use purple shampoo once or twice a week for maintenance, or the mask for stronger correction. All formulas are sulfate free, paraben free and cruelty free.

title: Evoque Healthy Care Series
description:
Healthy Care is Evoque's color-protection series, formulated for hair that is regularly dyed, highlighted or toned. Standard shampoos strip dye molecules out of the fiber with every wash. These non-ammonia, sulfate-free formulas cleanse gently, seal the cuticle and hold pigment in place so your color stays true for longer between salon visits.

The collection includes the Purifying Color Shampoo for removing product buildup without stripping dye, the Protective Conditioner for daily moisture and vibrancy, and the Reconstructive Leave-In Conditioner for detangling, repair and heat protection.

Shop individually or save with the Reconstructive Healthy Care Bundle in 380ml, 1L and Trio configurations, plus 100ml travel sizes. All formulas are sulfate free, paraben free and cruelty free, and are used in more than 10,000 U.S. salons.

title: Evoque Milk Therapy
description:
Evoque Milk Therapy is a milk protein hair care line for dry, brittle and color-treated hair. The milk protein shampoo and conditioner, masks and milk leave-in conditioners are built on milk protein, vitamin E and 12 essential amino acids to restore moisture, softness and shine.

Which one do you need? Everyday dryness: Hydrating Shampoo and Hydrating Conditioner. Very dry or damaged ends: the Deep Treatment Masque once a week. Frizz: the Yogurt Leave-In Deep Treatment Mask. Tangles and heat styling: the Two-Phase Leave-In Conditioner. Dull, dry ends: Silky Serum.

Sizes from 100ml travel to 1L and 2.8L salon sizes. Save with the Milk Therapy Bundle or the Power Trio. Sulfate free, paraben free and cruelty free.

title: Evoque Miracle Touch
description:
Miracle Touch is Evoque's bestselling anti-frizz line, formulated to create a water-resistant seal around the hair fiber so humidity cannot force the cuticle open.

The core products are the Leave-In Conditioner, a lightweight anti-frizz spray, the all-in-one BB Cream that repairs, hydrates and protects against heat up to 230°C, and the Shine Spray for a glossy salon finish. The Smart Care Shampoo and Conditioner and the Repair Hair Mask complete the wash routine.

Available from 100ml travel sizes up to 2.8L bulk salon bottles, and bundled in the Miracle Touch Trio and Set. Sulfate free, paraben free and cruelty free.

title: Evoque Smart Keratin
description:
The Evoque Smart Keratin collection is built for hair that has been damaged by heat, color, bleach or chemical straightening. Every formula pairs hydrolyzed keratin and amino acids with argan and macadamia oil to rebuild the hair fiber from the inside out, smooth the cuticle and lock out humidity.

The range covers the full routine: Smart Keratin Restorative Shampoo and Conditioner for daily repair, the Deep Treatment Mask for weekly intensive care, a lightweight Leave-In Conditioner and Frizz Control cream for all-day smoothness, plus Argan Oil and Oil Serum for shine and split-end sealing. Travel sizes and 1L salon sizes are available across the line.

Smart Keratin is also the go-to aftercare range for prolonging a professional keratin treatment. All products are sulfate free, paraben free and cruelty free, and are trusted by more than 10,000 salons across the United States.

title: Forming Cream
description:
Forming cream sits between a styling product and a treatment. It gives shape and natural, flexible hold without the stiffness of gel or the heaviness of wax, while argan, shea, macadamia and coconut oils keep hair conditioned rather than dried out.

It is the right choice for everyday, low-effort styling: piecey texture, soft definition and control that still lets hair move. Works on straight, wavy and lightly curly hair, and on all lengths.

Apply a small amount to damp or dry hair, emulsify between the palms and work through evenly, then shape with fingers. Build up gradually if you want more hold.

title: Hair Care Oils & Oil Treatments
description:
Hair oils are the finishing step that seals everything else in. Applied to damp hair before drying they act as a heat buffer; applied to dry ends they instantly smooth flyaways and add shine without a fresh wash.

The Smart Keratin Argan Oil is the all-rounder for dry, damaged and frizzy hair. The Smart Keratin Oil Serum is lighter and better suited to fine hair or a mid-day refresh. The Reconstructive Oil targets over-processed hair and split ends. The Milk Therapy Silky Serum with immortelle extract works on dehydrated, brittle hair.

Use one to three drops for fine hair, up to five for thick or coarse. Warm between palms and apply from mid-length to ends, never at the roots. Cruelty free.

title: Hair Care Products
description:
The complete Evoque Professional hair care catalog: shampoos, conditioners, deep treatment masks, leave-in conditioners, oils, serums, styling waxes and hair sprays. These are the same salon-grade formulas stocked by more than 10,000 hair salons across the United States, available directly to you.

The range is organized by concern. Milk Therapy hydrates dry and color-treated hair. Smart Keratin repairs damage and frizz. Miracle Touch delivers humidity-proof smoothness and shine. Healthy Care protects color. Scalp Recovery addresses hair fall and dandruff. Flawless Blonde tones blonde and silver hair. Plex Line rebuilds broken bonds. Macadamia nourishes thick, coarse hair.

Every formula is sulfate free, paraben free, cruelty free and suitable for all hair types. Free U.S. shipping on orders over $50.

title: Hair Care Serums - Repair, Nourish & Scalp Treatment
description:
Hair serums are concentrated leave-in treatments, applied in small amounts and left to work all day.

The Milk Therapy Silky Serum is a lightweight treatment oil with immortelle extract and milk proteins, formulated for dry, brittle and dehydrated hair. A few drops on mid-lengths and ends smooth the cuticle, seal split ends and add shine without any greasy residue.

The Scalp Recovery Anti Hair-Loss Serum works at the opposite end. Applied directly to the scalp and massaged in, its blend of piroctone olamine, argan and tea tree oil strengthens roots, calms irritation and helps reduce shedding. No rinsing required for either. Cruelty free.

title: Hair Care Sets & Bundles & Kits
description:
Buying an Evoque set or bundle is always cheaper than buying the same products separately, and it means the shampoo, conditioner and treatment in your routine are formulated to work together rather than against each other.

The range covers duos, trios and complete kits: Milk Therapy Power Trio and bundles for dry, color-treated hair; Smart Keratin and Keratin Bundles up to 2.8L for damage repair; the Miracle Touch Trio pairing BB Cream, Leave-In and Shine Spray; Reconstructive Healthy Care sets for color protection; the Scalp Recovery Set and Trio for hair fall and dandruff; the Plex Extreme S.O.S Bundle for bond repair; and the Hair Spray 3-Pack.

Travel-size duos in 100ml make TSA-friendly gifts and trial kits. Free U.S. shipping on orders over $50.

What are hair recovery kits?

Hair recovery kits combine several steps in one set so each product builds on the last. For damaged or chemically treated hair, the Plex Extreme S.O.S Bundle targets bond repair and the Smart Keratin bundles pair shampoo, conditioner and mask to rebuild strength and smoothness. For thinning or irritated scalps, the Scalp Recovery Set and Trio combine shampoo, conditioner and treatment to support hair fall and dandruff care.

title: Hair Color Cream
description:
Color care creams exist for one reason: dye starts washing out from the moment you leave the salon. These non-ammonia formulas seal the cuticle so pigment stays locked in the fiber for longer, while conditioning agents replace the moisture the coloring process removed.

Available in full and 100ml TSA-friendly travel sizes, they suit all shades but make the biggest visible difference on reds, coppers and fashion colors, which fade fastest.

Use after every wash on colored hair, focusing on mid-lengths and ends. Sulfate free, paraben free and cruelty free.

title: Hair Foam - Lightweight Styling & Toning Foams
description:
Hair foams deliver conditioning and toning in the lightest possible format — no residue, no stiffness, no weighing fine hair down.

The Flawless Blonde Purple Toning Foam is the standout: violet pigment neutralizes yellow and brassy tones in blonde, white and silver hair while lightly conditioning, keeping color salon-fresh between appointments. Because it is a leave-in, it tones gradually with each use rather than all at once, which makes over-toning far less likely than with a purple shampoo or mask.

Apply to damp, towel-dried hair, distribute evenly from roots to ends, then style as usual. No rinsing. Sulfate free, paraben free and cruelty free.

title: Hair Mask
description:
A weekly hair mask does what a daily conditioner cannot: with five to ten minutes of contact time, actives reach past the cuticle into the cortex where damage actually sits.

Choose by concern. Milk Therapy and Yogurt masks for dry, brittle and color-treated hair. Smart Keratin for damage, frizz and chemically-treated hair. Macadamia Cream Mask for thick, coarse density. Purple Mask to tone blonde, silver and platinum hair. Miracle Touch Repair Mask for humidity resistance. Hair Butter for the deepest moisture on curly and coarse textures.

Apply to clean, towel-dried hair, concentrate on mid-lengths and ends, leave 5–10 minutes, then rinse. Available in 50ml travel and 300–500ml salon sizes.

title: Hair Pomade and Wax
description:
Wax and pomade are the workhorses of men's styling, and the difference between them comes down to finish and how much you want to restyle during the day.

Matte options — Molding Matte and Liquid Matte Wax — give texture and definition with zero shine, for a natural, undone look. Shine options — Molding Shine and Liquid Shine Wax — add gloss for sharper, more polished styles. Power Aqua Gel Wax is water-based with mega hold for maximum structure. Creamy Wax is the softest, most restylable choice. The Ultra Hold Pomade is the classic slick-back option with all-day control and a glossy finish.

All formulas are water-soluble, so they wash out completely without buildup or flaking. Apply to damp or dry hair and style.

title: Hair Pomade For Men
description:
Hair pomade is the right choice when you want a sleek, polished, classic look — side parts, slick-backs and sharp defined styles that hold their shape all day.

The Evoque Ultra Hold Pomade delivers maximum control with a glossy finish, and stays put in humid conditions. Unlike traditional oil- or wax-based pomades, it is water-soluble, so it rinses out completely with a single wash instead of building up over days.

Apply a small amount to damp or towel-dried hair, work it through evenly with fingers or a comb, then shape. Add more only if you need extra hold. Salon-grade men's styling.

title: Hair Sprays
description:
Hair spray is the last step, and the one that decides whether your style survives the day. Evoque's sprays are built for hold without the two things people hate most: white flaking and a helmet-stiff feel.

Mega Hold is the everyday option — firm control that still lets hair move and brushes out cleanly at the end of the day. Ultra Hold is the maximum-strength choice for structured styles, updos and humid conditions. Both are humidity-resistant and leave no sticky residue.

The Hair Spray 3-Pack Bundle is the best value if spray is part of your daily routine. Hold the can 25–30cm from dry, finished hair and mist evenly.

title: Hair Styling Creamy
description:
Creamy styling products give shape and control while actively conditioning hair, which makes them the softest, most hair-friendly way to style.

The Miracle Touch BB Cream is the all-in-one option: it repairs damage, controls frizz, protects against heat up to 230°C and adds shine, all in a single leave-in step. The Moisturizing Forming Cream with argan, shea, macadamia and coconut oils gives natural, flexible hold for everyday styling.

Both apply to damp or dry hair and need no rinsing. Ideal for dry, frizz-prone and color-treated hair that reacts badly to alcohol-heavy styling products. Sulfate free and cruelty free.

title: Hair Styling Matte
description:
Matte styling wax is for anyone who wants texture and definition without looking like they used product. It absorbs light instead of reflecting it, so hair reads natural and undone even at ultra-strong hold.

It works especially well on short to medium lengths, textured crops, quiffs and messy styles, and on fine hair where shine can look greasy rather than polished.

Warm a small amount between your fingertips until it turns clear, then work through dry hair from back to front, building up gradually. Water-soluble, so it washes out with one shampoo and never flakes.

title: Hair Styling Mousse
description:
Styling mousse is the lightest way to add volume and body, which makes it the best option for fine or limp hair that gets weighed down by creams and waxes.

Evoque's mousses condition as they style: they add lift at the root and soft, flexible hold through the lengths without the crunch or residue associated with older mousse formulas. They also work as a base layer under a blow-dry to give the finished style more staying power.

Dispense a golf-ball-sized amount into your palm, apply to damp, towel-dried hair from roots to ends, then blow-dry or air-dry. No rinsing needed.

title: Hair Styling Products
description:
Evoque's hair styling range covers every finish and hold level, built on water-soluble formulas that wash out cleanly instead of building up over time.

For texture and definition, choose a wax: Molding Matte and Liquid Matte for a natural, shine-free look, Molding Shine and Liquid Shine for gloss, Power Aqua Gel Wax for mega hold, or Creamy Wax for a softer, restylable finish. For classic sleek styles, the Ultra Hold Pomade delivers all-day control with a polished shine.

Finish and set with Hair Spray in mega or ultra hold, both humidity-resistant and flake-free. For softer, conditioning styling, reach for the Moisturizing Forming Cream with argan, shea and macadamia oils, or a styling mousse for lift and body.

title: Leave in Conditioner
description:
Leave-in conditioners do the work your rinse-out conditioner cannot: they stay in the hair all day, keeping the cuticle sealed against humidity, providing heat protection before you reach for a dryer or iron, and making detangling effortless on wet or dry hair.

Choose by texture and need. Two-phase sprays like Milk Therapy and the Reconstructive Leave-In are the lightest option and best for fine hair and detangling. Creams such as Smart Keratin Frizz Control and Miracle Touch BB Cream carry more weight and control for thicker, frizz-prone hair. Mousses add body while conditioning. The Leave-In Rescue Spray is the fastest fix for damaged hair.

Most formulas here protect against heat up to 230°C. Apply to damp, towel-dried hair, mid-length to ends, and do not rinse. Sulfate free and cruelty free.

title: Macadamia Hair Care Series - Deep Nourishing Oils & Masks
description:
The Macadamia series is Evoque's nourishing line for normal to thick, coarse and dense hair that drinks up moisture. Macadamia oil is rich in palmitoleic acid, an omega-7 fatty acid naturally found in the scalp's own sebum, which makes it absorb quickly without leaving a heavy, greasy film.

Shop the Macadamia Shampoo in 1000ml and 2850ml bulk salon sizes, the Macadamia Hair Cream Mask 500ml for weekly deep treatment, and the money-saving Shampoo & Mask duo.

Use the shampoo two to three times a week and the cream mask once weekly, leaving it on for five to ten minutes. Expect softer texture, more manageable density and noticeably more shine. Sulfate free, paraben free and cruelty free.

title: Macademia Series
description:
The Macadamia series is Evoque's nourishing line for normal to thick, coarse and dense hair. Macadamia oil absorbs quickly because its fatty acid profile closely resembles the scalp's own sebum, so it softens and adds shine without the heavy film that heavier oils leave behind.

Shop the Macadamia Shampoo in 1000ml and 2850ml bulk salon sizes, the Macadamia Hair Cream Mask 500ml for weekly deep treatment, and the discounted Shampoo & Mask duo.

Use the shampoo two to three times weekly and the mask once a week for five to ten minutes. Sulfate free, paraben free and cruelty free.

title: Men’s Hair Care & Styling
description:
Evoque's men's grooming and styling range covers everything from the shower to the finished look, with water-soluble formulas that wash out clean and never flake.

For styling, pick your finish: Molding Matte and Liquid Matte Wax for natural, shine-free texture; Molding Shine and Liquid Shine Wax for gloss; Power Aqua Gel Wax for mega hold; Ultra Hold Pomade for sleek, classic styles; Creamy Wax for a softer, restylable hold. Lock it in with Hair Spray in mega or ultra hold.

For grooming, the 2-in-1 Beard Oil softens coarse facial hair while soothing the skin underneath, and the Moisturizing Shaving Gel gives a close, irritation-free shave. Add the Green Clay Face Mask for deep cleansing on acne-prone skin, and Scalp Recovery products for thinning hair.

title: Miracle Touch
description:
Miracle Touch is Evoque's bestselling line and its answer to one specific problem: humidity. These formulas create a water-resistant seal around the hair fiber, so frizz does not return the moment you step outside.

The hero products are the Miracle Touch Leave-In Conditioner, a lightweight anti-frizz spray, the all-in-one BB Cream that repairs, hydrates and protects against heat up to 230°C, and the Shine Spray for an instant glossy, salon-finish top coat. The Miracle Touch Trio bundles all three.

The wash routine is covered too: Smart Care Shampoo and Conditioner in 100ml travel through to 2.8L bulk salon sizes, plus the Repair Hair Mask 300ml for weekly intensive treatment. Sulfate free, paraben free and cruelty free.

title: Mousse
description:
Hair mousse is the lightest way to add body and control without the weight of a cream or the stiffness of a gel. Evoque's mousses double as treatments rather than pure styling products.

The Milk Therapy Mousse Conditioner is a leave-in that detangles, hydrates and softens dry, color-treated hair while adding lift at the root. The Flawless Blonde Purple Mousse carries violet pigment to neutralize brassy tones in blonde, silver and platinum hair, so you tone and style in a single step.

Apply to damp, towel-dried hair, work through from roots to ends, then blow-dry or air-dry. No rinsing needed. Sulfate free, paraben free and cruelty free.

title: Oil Hair Masks - Deep Nourishing & Repair Treatments
description:
Oil-based hair masks go further than a standard conditioning mask. Where protein masks rebuild structure, oil masks restore the lipid layer that heat, bleach and hard water strip away — the layer responsible for softness, shine and manageability.

The range centers on argan, macadamia, shea butter and coconut oil. The Hair Butter is the richest option and the best choice for coarse, curly and very dry hair. The Macadamia Cream Mask suits thick, dense hair. Smart Keratin and Milk Therapy masks combine oils with keratin or milk proteins for repair plus nourishment.

Apply to clean, towel-dried hair, leave 5–10 minutes, then rinse thoroughly. Once a week is enough for most hair types.

title: Plex Line
description:
The Plex Line is Evoque's bond-repair system for hair that has been pushed past the point normal conditioning can fix: heavily bleached, over-processed, chemically straightened or mechanically broken.

Bleaching and chemical services break the disulfide bonds that give hair its strength and elasticity. Plex Extreme S.O.S Shampoo and Conditioner work to reconnect those bonds while tea tree and macadamia oils restore softness and drive color deeper into the fiber, so your color holds longer and fades more evenly.

Available individually in 1000ml salon size or as the discounted Plex Extreme S.O.S Shampoo & Conditioner Bundle. Use as your regular wash routine on damaged hair, or as targeted aftercare in the four to six weeks following a bleach or lightening service. Sulfate free and cruelty free.

title: Shampoo
description:
Every Evoque professional shampoo in one place, chosen by hair concern. Each product page lists the full ingredients, so you can see which formulas are sulfate free before you buy.

Choose by concern: Milk Therapy Hydrating Shampoo for dry, brittle, color-treated hair; Smart Keratin Restorative Shampoo for damage and frizz; Miracle Touch Smart Care for humidity resistance and shine; Healthy Care Purifying Color Shampoo for buildup removal; Purple Shampoo to neutralize brass in blonde, silver and platinum hair; Scalp Recovery Anti Hair Loss Shampoo for shedding and dandruff; Plex Extreme S.O.S for bond repair; Macadamia Shampoo for thick, coarse hair.

Sizes run from 100ml TSA-friendly travel bottles to 1L, 2.8L and 2.85L bulk salon sizes. Paraben free and cruelty free.

title: Shampoo & Conditioner
description:
Matched shampoo and conditioner sets from every Evoque line, formulated to work together so the conditioner replaces exactly what the shampoo cleanses away. Buying the duo is consistently cheaper than buying each bottle separately.

Choose by hair concern: Milk Therapy for dry, brittle and color-treated hair; Smart Keratin for damage, frizz and chemically-treated hair; Miracle Touch for humidity resistance and shine; Healthy Care for protecting color; Scalp Recovery for hair fall and dandruff; Plex Extreme S.O.S for bond repair on badly broken hair.

Every duo is available in multiple sizes, from 100ml TSA-friendly travel sets up to 1L and 2.8L bulk salon sizes for professional use. All formulas are sulfate free, paraben free and cruelty free.

title: Special Offers
description:
Current deals and special offers across the Evoque professional range. This is where discounted bundles, multi-buy savings and reduced salon sizes live.

The biggest per-ounce savings are always in the larger formats: 1L and 2.8L bottles cost significantly less per wash than travel or 380ml sizes. Matched shampoo and conditioner duos, trios and complete kits are priced below the cost of buying each product separately.

Free U.S. shipping applies on orders over $50, and discount codes can be applied at checkout. Offers rotate, so it is worth checking back before you reorder your regular routine.

title: Thick and Curly
description:
Thick, coarse and curly hair has a different problem to fine hair: the cuticle is naturally raised, so moisture escapes quickly and humidity gets in just as fast. It needs richer, heavier formulas than standard hair care provides.

The Hair Butter with shea, argan, macadamia and coconut oils is the deepest moisture option in the range. The Macadamia series — shampoo and cream mask — is built specifically for dense, thick hair. Miracle Touch leave-ins and BB Cream seal against humidity for lasting frizz control and definition.

Curly hair benefits most from applying products to soaking-wet hair and scrunching rather than combing through. Sulfate free, paraben free and cruelty free.

title: Travel Size 100ml
description:
Every Evoque travel size in one place, all at or under the 100ml TSA carry-on limit so they go straight into your hand luggage without a second thought.

Travel sizes are also the cheapest way to try a line before committing to a full bottle. The 100ml range covers Milk Therapy, Smart Keratin, Miracle Touch and Healthy Care shampoos and conditioners, plus matched travel duos. The 50ml masks — Purple Mask, Milk Therapy Creamy Milk Mask and Yogurt Leave-In Mask — give you a full weekly treatment in a gym-bag-sized jar.

They also make easy gifts, stocking fillers and salon retail samples. All sulfate free, paraben free and cruelty free.
